Here's a concise sales script your team can use if someone asks about the **"50 New Clients in 30 Days"** ad.

> **Prospect:** "Your ad says 50 new clients in 30 days. How does that work?"
>
> **Response:**
>
> "Great question. That offer is actually reserved for a small number of premium clients who already have the infrastructure, capacity, and advertising budget to support that level of growth.
>
> To consistently target 50 new clients in 30 days, a practice typically needs to be prepared to invest significantly in paid advertising, have the operational systems in place, and be able to handle that volume of new patients.
>
> For most practices, we don't recommend starting there. Instead, we build a strategy around where your business is today and create a realistic growth plan that delivers the best ROI.
>
> If, after looking at your numbers, it makes sense for you, we'll absolutely discuss whether you're a fit for our premium growth program. If not, we'll recommend the path that's going to generate the strongest results for your current stage."

### If they ask, "So why advertise 50 clients?"

> "Because it's absolutely achievable under the right conditions. The key is that every practice is different. Rather than selling everyone the same package, we customize the strategy based on your revenue, capacity, goals, market, and advertising budget. Our job isn't to sell you the biggest program—it's to recommend the one that's most likely to succeed for your practice."

### Internal coaching note for your sales team

Never defend the ad. Reframe it. The ad starts the conversation; the sales call determines the right solution. Position the **50-client program** as an elite, invitation-only growth offer for practices that already have the budget, team, and systems to support that pace of growth. Everyone else gets the strategy that's appropriate for their current stage, which builds credibility instead of creating skepticism.
